narration.full_text: In this section, we'll dive into the world of linear equations. You'll learn how to define and identify pairs of linear equations in two variables, which are fundamental to solving many real-world problems. We'll also cover how to formulate these equations from word problems, transforming everyday scenarios into mathematical expressions. A key part of our journey will be mastering various methods to solve systems of linear equations, including graphical, substitution, and elimination techniques. Furthermore, we'll explore the conditions that determine whether a system has a unique solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions. Finally, you'll see how to apply these powerful methods to solve practical, real-world problems, making mathematics truly come alive.
